description:
I'm a BS Robotics and Intelligent Systems student interested in space exploration, robotics, AI, and engineering. I have experience with Python, C++, Arduino, and basic software development. I'm excited to explore new ideas and build something meaningful using NASA's open data.

I'm looking for enthusiastic teammates with skills in coding, software/web development, AI/ML, data analysis, and space exploration. Curiosity, creativity, teamwork, and a willingness to learn are always welcome!
